notes: Capcom Kingpin C1.03 Solenoid Test walk on fresh isolated state. The DMD names each coil as S01-S32 with its wire colours, connector pin and supply; each selection fires that coil, so every step's solenoid transitions pair a displayed S-number with the public solenoid address. Menu navigation uses public 8 (coin door), 7 (Start) and the flipper buttons; retain the DMD frames to prove the path taken. Flipper buttons are pressed through PinMAME's flipper-column button bits (public 84 left, 82 right): kpb105 declares FLIP_SWNO(5,6), and with keyboard handling off core_updateSw copies those bits into matrix switches 5/6 every frame, so a direct host write to 5 or 6 lasts at most one frame.
